code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    shape=[(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c]==1]
    rs=[r for r,c in shape]; cs=[c for r,c in shape]
    top,left=min(rs),min(cs)
    pattern={(r-top,c-left) for r,c in shape}
    # The repeated color bar gives the copy colors in its reading order.
    bars=[]
    for c in range(w):
        vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]]
        if len(vals)>=2 and len(set(vals))==1: bars.append((c,vals[0]))
    if bars:
        colors=[]
        for c,col in bars:
            if not colors or colors[-1]!=col: colors.append(col)
        # Color bar at the side of the canvas: consecutive columns encode colors.
        if len(colors)>1:
            pass
    # Find horizontal repeated multicolor bar (same sequence on multiple rows).
    seq=None
    for r in range(h):
        vals=[grid[r][c] for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
        if len(vals)>1 and len(set(vals))>1:
            seq=vals; break
    if seq is None:
        # vertical multicolor palette
        for c in range(w):
            vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]]
            if len(vals)>1 and len(set(vals))>1: seq=vals; break
    if not seq: seq=[1]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    sh=len(set(rs)); sw=len(set(cs))
    start=top-(len(seq)//2)*sh
    for i,col in enumerate(seq):
        for dr,dc in pattern:
            rr=start+i*sh+dr
            cc=left+dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w: out[rr][cc]=col
    return out
'''
